source: Re-verification of 19 flagged changes, 18 Nov 2026: district portals, municipal sites, Census 2011 PCA geographic-unit lists, LGD sub-district feed
why: Of six disputed structural changes all were confirmed (Tirupati NMA and Vemulawada R are census labels for the towns themselves). Of 13 unconfirmed renames, 10 were confirmed; Mundra is reverted to the town name people write, Ganj Basoda takes the municipal spelling, and Haldwani gains its municipal body's name as an alias. (The Mundra and Ganjbasoda corrections were made in the original operations in 33/34, not stacked here as reversals, so the stage stays idempotent.)
